turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you help me draft the initial system prompt for the new Voice Mode module? I want it to handle interruptions gracefully.
Sure, Alan. I can draft that. Should the assistant pause its speech stream when it detects user speech?
Yes, exactly. Also, keep in mind that Voice Mode system prompts should prohibit synchronous cc_orchestrate calls. We need to avoid blocking the audio thread.
Got it. I will ensure the prompt explicitly forbids synchronous cc_orchestrate calls to maintain low latency.
Perfect. By the way, did you check if the new microphone cables arrived? I ordered three XLRs last Tuesday.
I don't have access to your email, so I can't check tracking. But I can remind you to check your inbox if you'd like.
No worries, I'll look. Back to the prompt—just make sure the tone is concise and friendly.
Understood. I'll draft a concise, friendly prompt that adheres to the non-blocking constraint.
